# AWS Quantum Computing

Amazon Braket skills for the main agent: building, simulating, and running quantum circuits and hybrid jobs on Braket devices.

## How it works

This is a **vertical plugin**: its skills, commands, and MCP servers attach directly to your main agent, with no sub-agent hand-off. Prefer the the matching agent plugin when you want an isolated specialist instead.

- Install: `claude plugin install aws-quantum-computing@talkops-devops-plugins`
- Skills activate from their descriptions; invoke one explicitly with `/aws-quantum-computing:<skill>`

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `amazon-braket` | Runs quantum computing workflows on AWS through Amazon Braket — discovering devices (QPUs and simulators) and their availability, building gate-model circuits and analog Hamiltonian programs, submitting quantum tasks, p… |

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/aws-quantum-computing:run-circuit` | Build and run a quantum circuit on Amazon Braket |

## MCP servers

Declared in [`.mcp.json`](./.mcp.json); started when the plugin is enabled and available to the main agent.

| Server | Transport | Launch | Tool names | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aws-mcp` | stdio | `uvx mcp-proxy-for-aws-cli==1.7.0` `--skip-auth --metadata` | `mcp__plugin_aws-quantum-computing_aws-mcp__*` | Managed AWS MCP Server via the toolkit's pinned proxy (aws___call_aws, aws___search_documentation, aws___retrieve_skill, ...). |

AWS credentials are inherited from the host environment (`AWS_PROFILE`, SSO, or instance role). `AWS_REGION` defaults to `us-east-1` when unset. Toggle any server off per project in `/mcp`.
